title: S40 The You Do "evidence" is hand-ticked or invented.
description:

Dónde (campo del contenido): `youDo.starterCode` (qa_scenarios, comment block before `status, missing = readiness(evidence)`)

Give the QA scenario a declared synthetic `observed_ms` fixture with its provenance noted («medición sintética del fixture CASO-LIM-040-1A»), or replace it with a timing she runs locally (`time.perf_counter` around a stub).
